parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID.
- Enterprise Enterprise instance: This parameter is required. You can view the ID of your Enterprise Enterprise instance on the **Instance Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.
- Public instance: This parameter is not required.

parameters.name: ProductKeys
parameters.description: The list of ProductKey values of the products to be associated with the project.

parameters.name: ProjectId
parameters.description:
The project ID.
1. Log on to the [IoT Studio console](https://studio.iot.aliyun.com/?spm=a2c4g.11186623.2.8.1e7830fagdybMb). In the upper-left corner, select the instance. In the left-side navigation pane, click Project Management.
2. In the common project list, find the target project, click the project card, and then view the project ID in the address bar.
